toolSections.title: Sentry API
toolSections.description: Your Sentry sign-in provides MCP tools. Add a personal token to use the REST API too.

signIn.description: Sentry MCP tools through Sentry sign-in. The REST API needs a personal token.
Sentry MCP and Sentry API tools with a personal token.

steps: In Sentry, open User settings > Personal Tokens and choose Create New Token.
Name it Signalbox. For Sentry's standard MCP tools select org:read, project:write, team:write, event:write, and alerts:write.
Create the token, paste it into Personal token, and choose your organization's region, us or de.
credentials.note: A personal token provides Sentry MCP and Sentry API tools. Tools can only use the permissions you grant. Add other REST scopes only for the operations you need.

token.label: Personal token
token.expectedFormat: Paste the token itself, without a Bearer prefix.

region.label: Region
region.expectedFormat: Use us or de for your organization's region.

connectionGuidance.alternativeLabel: Use a personal token for MCP and API
